subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this issue require native WebChat linkification, or should the first repair be limited to Control UI tool-output cards?
rationale: Current main shows both surfaces lack the behavior, but the browser fix is much narrower and the issue body says native WebChat only if applicable.

options.title: Scope Control UI first
options.body: Implement safe linkification across Control UI tool-card output paths now and track native WebChat separately if maintainers want parity.

options.title: Require cross-client parity
options.body: Keep this issue as one cross-client UX fix and require both Control UI and native WebChat behavior before closing.

options.title: Browser-only product decision
options.body: Retitle or clarify the issue as browser Control UI only and leave native WebChat unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Scope Control UI first
recommendation.body: Implement safe linkification across Control UI tool-card output paths now and track native WebChat separately if maintainers want parity.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest routing owner from the prior maintainer-side review and recent current-main work on both chat UI surfaces.
